featured_reviews.name: rAsool jamindar
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best place to buy original Top Brand clothing. 💯trustworthy.  Let me tell you my story. I saw this store randomly  on insta and later decided to order  few tshirt and jeans , I placed order got the dock Id but when I checked online it wasnt showing on courier website (though it wasnt thier mistake it was late because it was weekend and on saturday it was dussera so it was holiday) I was curious  and tensed as it was my first order through them but beleive me, every time I called them to ask regaring my parcel status Maaz bhai himself picked the call and even called from his side too to solve the issue. Hes such a genuine person and his product are really awesome.  Their back-hand support team is really friendly.  🙌🏻👍🏻💯
